lines.text: @maya_front grips the wheel of her first car with hands, breathes, and turns the key.
Interior, low angle up at her.

writes.note: I tightened the action to one 15-word beat so the shot plays in 2.5 seconds.

reply.rationale: The original ran 19 words, about 3.2 s by rule 10. A single 15-word action line counts 2.5 s, and the direction stays last and untimed.
